question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_season AS (
    SELECT 
        rac.year,
        r.driver_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT rac.round) AS num_rounds
    FROM results r
    JOIN races rac ON r.race_id = rac.race_id
    WHERE rac.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY rac.year, r.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rac.round) >= 2
),
first_last AS (
    SELECT 
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.constructor_id,
        d.first_round,
        d.last_round,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.driver_id ORDER BY d.first_round ASC) AS rn_first,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.year, d.driver_id ORDER BY d.last_round DESC) AS rn_last
    FROM drives d
    WHERE d.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id FROM first_last WHERE rn_first = 1
),
last_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id FROM first_last WHERE rn_last = 1
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fd.year, fd.driver_id, fd.constructor_id AS constructor_id
    FROM first_drives fd
    JOIN last_drives ld ON fd.year = ld.year AND fd.driver_id = ld.driver_id
    JOIN driver_season ds ON fd.year = ds.year AND fd.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    WHERE fd.constructor_id = ld.constructor_id
)

FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers dr ON q.driver_id = dr.driver_id
ORDER BY dr.surname, dr.forename
